latest_release.name: TorchVision 0.29.2
latest_release.body:
This is a minor release with no new feature. It's compatible with PyTorch 2.14 and later.

### Improvements

[packaging] Build a single `py3-none` wheel per platform, covering all supported CPython versions including free-threaded builds (#9643)

### Bug Fixes

[datasets] Use `filter='data'` when extracting tar archives, to prevent path traversal outside the target directory (#9694)
[ops] Add more input checks to the CPU `roi_align`, `roi_pool`, `ps_roi_align` and `ps_roi_pool` kernels. Out-of-range batch indices, bad rois/grad shapes and oversized sampling grids now raise an error instead of accessing memory out of bounds (#9684)

Various code-quality improvements: #9660, #9700, #9579, #9663, #9667, #9671, #9669, #9685


### Contributors

Thanks to Adrian Abeyta, Andrey Talman, Dmitry Nikolaev, Huy Do and Nicolas Hug.
